title: Harmony House: Comfort + Convenience in East Nash
description:
Welcome to our cozy, single-family bungalow located in East Nashville! This inviting retreat offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience, making it the best choice for your Nashville stay. Ideally situated, we’re just a walk away from a variety of local restaurants, bars,  coffee shops and grocery stores, ensuring you have everything you need right at your doorstep. For exploring Nashville further, a 10-15 minute Uber ride will get you to Broadway and all the best Music City hangouts!

The space
Our home features 2 comfortable bedrooms with their own smart TVs, and 1 full bathroom, accommodating up to 4 guests. It has a fully equipped kitchen for all your cooking needs,  a fenced in backyard perfect for a cookout or relaxing outdoors and office space for all your business needs. You’ll have the entire property to yourself, ensuring privacy and tranquility throughout your stay.

Guest access
Guests will have full access to the entire property, including all amenities. Whether you’re planning a quiet night in or a cookout in the backyard, you’ll find everything you need for a memorable stay. (We do have 2 small storage buildings in the back yard that are not accessible to guests.)

Other things to note
Dogs will be considered on a case by case basis and must be approved by host prior to booking. Unfortunately, we cannot allow cats at this time.
